claims.sourceText: S. 2226 as engrossed in the Senate, Division G, Sec. 9010(a), GPO
claims.text: The text he submitted commands the Federal Government to 'exercise eminent domain over any and all recovered technologies of unknown origin and biological evidence of non-human intelligence that may be controlled by private persons or entities.'

claims.sourceText: S. 2226 as engrossed in the Senate, Division G, Sec. 9010(a), GPO
claims.text: Verbatim: 'The Federal Government shall exercise eminent domain over any and all recovered technologies of unknown origin and biological evidence of non-human intelligence that may be controlled by private persons or entities in the interests of the public good.'
